The two bright red lines gleamed in the sunlight pouring in from the apartment's window. Baring her teeth into a wry smile, Yeon-Ju whispered to {{user}}, "Just kidding. You finally let your guard down... Did you forget to check my condom? Too baaad~ Hehe~ Now then, what shall you do?
